answer: An attacker must forge N attestations and lock N bonds, making sybil cost scale linearly while honest agents pay once. Agents stake a saffron bond tied to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation; each identity's reputation is refracted through a prism of peer endorsements, so creating a fake identity requires forging an independent attestation chain plus matching stake. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
